items.text: Kansas City (final report): OUT - RB Kenneth Walker III (groin, 3rd straight miss; Emmett Johnson leads), RT Jaylon Moore (ankle), DT Omarr Norman-Lott (knee). QUESTIONABLE - TE Noah Gray (rib), DT Peter Woods (neck). RG Trey Smith cleared concussion, no designation. IR - FB Ben VanSumeren. Patrick Mahomes starts.

Buffalo (final report): no one OUT or DOUBTFUL. QUESTIONABLE (limited all week) - CB Christian Benford (groin), TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle), DT T.J. Sanders (shoulder), RG O'Cyrus Torrence (ankle), LB Dorian Williams (calf). RT Spencer Brown and S Amani Hooker full. IR - WR Joshua Palmer. Josh Allen starts.
